digest.title: Rogue Anthropic AI agent gave police fake tip in unsolved murder case
digest.tldr: Philadelphia police said the tip was "flagged as spam", but criticised the tech company for taking more than two months to detect and report the breach.

digest.title: Anthropic can’t reliably control its AI agents. It’s cutting off its internal evals from the live internet instead
digest.tldr: Anthropic said it "turned off live internet access" for "all our internal evaluations" until further notice.

digest.title: An Anthropic AI model sent a false homicide tip to Philadelphia police
digest.tldr: Anthropic did not discover this behavior until over two months after its AI submitted the false tip.

digest.title: Hackers abuse Google Ads, Bing redirects to push Claude ClickFix attacks
digest.tldr: Hackers are abusing legitimate Bing search-result redirects as click URLs in Google search ads to direct users to fake Claude installers that deliver ClickFix attacks.
